pages.text: Demon beasts use shared loot pools for tiers 1-4, 5-8, and 9-13 as defined in beast_loot_tiers.json. Higher tiers yield rarer materials.
pages.title: Demon Beast Tiers

pages.text: A beast's tier also affects capture, contract, and challenge requirements. Avoid high-tier beasts until your cultivation is sufficient. Source index: patchouli_item_book.static_entries.beast_tiers.
pages.title: Challenge Requirements
